messages:
maya: quick readout — ran citrine13b int8 vs int6 microbench + 1k-sample GTN slice this morning. attaching quick numbers inline.
simon: awesome, drop the numbers pls.
maya: tl;dr: int6 is ~3.2x cheaper per token but we see a small drop in QA exact-match on the product slice (~2.5 pp). latency p50 slightly better on int6, p95 worse on long-context prompts.
andre: can you paste the perf table?
maya: 
```
model                  | p50  | p95  | tok/s | cost/token
citrine13b-int8        | 110ms| 380ms| 260   | $0.00078
citrine13b-int6        | 95ms | 540ms| 300   | $0.00024
citrine13b-int6+kvcache | 80ms | 420ms| 330   | $0.00024
```

beth: what's the exact-match numbers on the GTN slice?
maya: GTN slice (1k queries, majority short Q/A + multi-turn): int8 EM=72.4%, int6 EM=69.9% (delta -2.5). precision@1 for high-confidence queries (top decile) is nearly identical.
simon: that's pretty encouraging. any weird failure modes? hallucination rate?
maya: we instrumented hallucination via our heuristic: int8 halluc rate 6.1%, int6 7.3% (increase concentrated on long-context retrievals and multi-hop reasoning).
andre: so cost tradeoff: saving ~69%/token but small QA degradation. recommendation?
maya: ops recs: (1) rollout int6 as default for non-sensitive routes (search completions, assistant-summaries) with a 10-20% sample to int8 for QA calibration; (2) enable kv-cache for multi-turn to regain p95 latency; (3) gate certain prompt types (retrieval + reasoning) to int8 via a cheap classifier; (4) monitor recall/EM on production GTN targets with daily alert if delta > 1.5pp.
simon: for GTN product ask: what should we tell the PMs?
maya: tell PMs: ~3x token cost reduction likely, expected small quality hit on complex QA. We recommend phased rollout: 1 week canary at 5% traffic, 2 week 25% if metrics stable. Provide fallback policy to int8 when classification score low.
beth: do we need eval-bot to run any extra probes?
maya: yes — eval-bot please run the following nightly slices for one week: 1) long-context multi-hop (200 samples), 2) retrieval QA (500), 3) product prompt synthetic stress (500). Flag any slice with >1.5pp EM drop or >2pp hallucation delta.
eval-bot: ack — scheduled nightly runs starting 2026-03-22. I'll post results to #eng-ml/weekly-evals.
andre: deployment notes for eng-platform?
maya: eng-platform: enable a new model variant tag citrine13b:int6-canary, add routing policy: default -> int6, classifier -> int8, canary -> int8 sample 10%. Also add cost tag for billing dashboards.
simon: one more thing — unit econ estimate for product ops: with typical session length 120 tokens, delta cost per session int8=$0.094, int6=$0.028. Annualized at 1M sessions = savings ~$66k.
beth: great. I'll sync with GTN PM and propose phased plan.
maya: filing a short playbook doc after this thread with the numbers and the canary checklist. anyone want to add gating heuristics?
andre: cheap heuristic: if prompt contains >=2 URLs or contains token "see sources" -> route to int8. works for retrievaly tasks.
simon: :thumbsup: let's keep an eye on p95 tail after kv-cache enabled.
maya: thanks all — I'll push the rollout PR and the playbook link here when ready. :rocket:
